posts.title: The Ultimate Guide to Indie Beat Production
posts.content:
Creating high-fidelity, commercially competitive instrumental beats from a home setup requires attention to three fundamental areas: gain staging, melodic texturing, and drum carving.

First, always make sure to keep your individual element tracks around -12dBFS to maintain peak headroom at the master bus. Second, layers should serve a structural purpose; mixing a pad, an arp, and a lead is fine, but make sure they don't fight for the same 400Hz - 2kHz frequencies.

In our digital shop, we have released our Vol. 1 Exclusive Beat Pack where we apply these exact formulas. Grab it in the store tab!
